name: Reefwrack Drake
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The reefwrack drake makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Wrecking Surge.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

Actions.name: Bone-Chum Spray (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 67 (15d8) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Wrecking Surge
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the reefwrack drake, and the target has the Prone condition.

lore: A brine-soaked dragon that claims a shallow reef as its larder, beaching vessels to feast on crews and returning the bones to the water as chum for the gulls that follow it.

generation.userConcept: a reef-drake that beaches ships, swallows the crew whole, spits the bones back as chum, and calls gulls to pick the water clean
